integrity: The code is reconstructed from the published generator factors. Exact finite enumeration verifies the ordinary parameters, Hermitian LCD property, all column-subspace maxima, the seven generalized Hamming weights, and the dual hierarchy.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicit \([21,7,11]\) one-generator quasi-cyclic code in the cited 2026 source. It does not classify all quaternary codes with those ordinary parameters or assert equivalence with earlier constructions.
title: The optimal quaternary \([21,7,11]\) quasi-cyclic LCD code has weight hierarchy \((11,14,16,18,19,20,21)\)
